description.en: The ID of the building rule.

description.zh:
构建镜像架构，取值：

- `linux/amd64`

-  `linux/arm64`

- `linux/386`

- `linux/arm/v7`

- `linux/arm/v6`

默认值：`linux/amd64`
description.en:
Architecture for image building. Valid values:

*   `linux/amd64`
*   `linux/arm64`
*   `linux/386`
*   `linux/arm/v7`
*   `linux/arm/v6`

Default value: `linux/amd64`
The name of the push that triggers the building rule.

description.zh:
推送类型，取值：

- `GIT_TAG`：TAG触发

- `GIT_BRANCH`：分支触发
description.en:
The type of the push that triggers the building rule. Valid values:

*   `GIT_TAG`: tag push
*   `GIT_BRANCH`: branch push
The ID of the image repository.
